2. Sample Data for Initial Load.

B2K_ID='PA1538691' AND B2K_TYPE='ACCNT'  (WILL BE UPDATED) .
B2K_ID='PA1542273' AND B2K_TYPE='ACCNT' (WILL BE DELETED) . 
B2K_ID='PA2437724' AND B2K_TYPE='ACCNT'  (UNCHANGED) .
B2K_ID='9999' AND B2K_TYPE='ACCNT' (NEW RECORD) . 

select B2K_ID B2K_ID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT B2K_ID B2K_ID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_ASSTCLASSDETAIL WHERE B2K_ID='PA1538691' AND B2K_TYPE='ACCNT' 
UNION ALL
SELECT B2K_ID B2K_ID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_ASSTCLASSDETAIL WHERE B2K_ID='PA1542273' AND B2K_TYPE='ACCNT' 
UNION ALL
SELECT B2K_ID B2K_ID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_ASSTCLASSDETAIL WHERE B2K_ID='PA2437724' AND B2K_TYPE='ACCNT' 
UNION ALL
SELECT B2K_ID B2K_ID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_ASSTCLASSDETAIL WHERE B2K_ID='9999' AND B2K_TYPE='ACCNT'  ) temp order by B2K_ID, SCD_START_DATE
